mapper.select: SELECT id, organization_name, tax_code, address, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_job_title, note, status, created_at, updated_at, row_version FROM public.organizations WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, organization_name, tax_code, address, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_job_title, note, status, created_at, updated_at, row_version FROM public.organizations WHERE tax_code = #{taxCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.organizations ( id, organization_name, tax_code, address, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_job_title, note, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationName}, #{taxCode}, #{address}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactJobTitle}, #{note}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE public.organizations SET organization_name = #{organization.organizationName}, tax_code = #{organization.taxCode}, address = #{organization.address}, contact_name = #{organization.contactName}, contact_phone = #{organization.contactPhone}, contact_job_title = #{organization.contactJobTitle}, note = #{organization.note}, status = #{organization.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{organization.id} AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
